name: Shandong Link Science and Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Link Science and Technology Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells carbon black, precipitated hydrated silica, and industrial sodium silicate in China and internationally. The company serves basic chemical raw materials in tires, footwear, silicone rubber, rubber rollers, wires and cables, battery separators, and agricultural products. Its products are used in pharmaceuticals, masterbatches, chemical fibers and other fields. Shandong Link Science and Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Weifang, China.
